simple.meaning: בּוּזִי (Bûwzîy) appears once in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with priesthood.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Ezekiel, beginning at Ezekiel 1:3. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family line, priesthood, land.
